newsitem.title: JAPAN: Moody's puts Sega long-term rating under review.
newsitem.headline: Moody's puts Sega long-term rating under review.

text.p: Moody's Investors Service said on Friday that it had put its rating for Sega Enterprises Ltd's long-term debt under review for a possible downgrade.

It also said in a statement that it had put the euro medium-term note programme of Sega's keepwell-supported subsidiary, Sega International Finance B.V., under review for a possible downgrade as well as the Baa2 senior unsecured long-term debt rating for Sega itself.
The move reflects Sega's announcement that it will merge with toy maker Bandai Co Ltd later this year, Moody's said.
Bandai is not rated by Moody's, it said.

Moody's said that the global battle for supremacy in video game hardware between Sega's Sega Saturn, Sony Corp's PlayStation and Nintendo Co Ltd's Nintendo 64 and their successors would continue to intensify for the next few years.
